text:
tara: FYI RedTeamCo scheduled a whitebox run next week. We need a quick gaps checklist: RBAC scope, KMS access, evidence ingestion, and retest cadence. cc @mateo @nisha
mateo: Let's limit to staging and CI infra. No production access. Prefer ephemeral SSO roles with strict IP allowlist.
kevin: I'll draft an IAM role `pt-external-assessor` with session policy limiting to the staging account only. Will also attach a KMS policy scoped to alias/redwood-pt-2026.
nisha: Audit requirements: enable CloudTrail management + S3 object-level data events for the evidence bucket, forward to Splunk, tag events with `pt-id` and `engagement`. Retention 1yr.
tara: Uploads: vendor will push to presigned S3 prefix. We require x-amz-meta-sha256 and filename pattern `eng-{id}/{report-type}/{file}`. Also require ObjectLock retention (GOVERNANCE) 14d.
kevin: Minimal KMS statement (for vendor review):
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-key-2026"
}
```
mateo: For the presign service, enforce a max PUT size 200MB, require checksum header, and log successful uploads to a dedicated audit log prefix. Add a post-upload lambda that validates checksums and moves objects to locked prefix.
audit-bot: [INFO] Presign service must emit structured logs: {"service":"presign","pt_id":"<id>","uploader":"vendor"} (for SIEM ingestion)
nisha: Retest policy: vendor requests retest window; we offer two slots: low-traffic overnight (01:00-03:00 PT) or early morning (06:00-08:00 PT). Oncall should confirm staffing. Post-window immediate key rotation for any keys used.
oncall: [BOT] PagerDuty stub created: PD-PT-2026-01.
toncall: whoops typo
oncall: staffing confirmed for 01:00-03:00 PT slot. I'll be oncall and will rotate keys post-window.
tara: Remediation intake: vendor may create tickets via webhook to our vuln-tracker; we triage internally then tag `pt-report`. SLA: ack within 24h, fix plan in 3 business days for critical, 7 for non-critical.
kevin: Action items: create role + KMS policy + IP condition (owner: kevin, due: EOD), share JSON session policy with vendor.
mateo: action: setup presign pipeline + checksum validator + ObjectLock (owner: mateo, due: EOD).
nisha: action: enable CloudTrail data events + SIEM forward + set retention (owner: nisha, due: EOD).
tara: I'll send vendor onboarding email with checklist and the S3 prefix. Draft link -> https://docs.internal.redwood/pt-onboard (sending now).
kevin: ack
mateo: ack
nisha: ack
tara: closing thread unless blockers. Reopen if vendor asks for AWS KMS grant changes. Thanks everyone!
